integrity: Two exact exhaustive standard-library verification scripts are included; the proofs distinguish finite checks from the structural spectral argument. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the 30 fully labelled order-seven Steiner triple systems. The known 15+15 partition and line-intersection properties are credited; the low-degree sampling ranks, spectral derivation and cubic witness are the claimed additions. No assertion for higher-order designs.
title: Cubic Fourier recovery and the orientation-blind quadratic frame of the thirty labelled Fano planes
